name: The Horrids
bio:
Radikal Moodz and Shred'er combine the best of their imagination into a fresh style with energetic basslines and grooves, surrounded by organic textures broken by digital rhythms. Together they build a full 3D world to travel inside, unique of its kind.

A fairy-tale journey with twisted sounds, off-beat sequences and crazy sound design.

name: Anchronorium
bio:
Anchronorium is the DarkPsy project of Portuguese producer Rafyx, exploring high-intensity soundscapes built on dissonant textures, immersive atmospheres and fast, driving rhythms. His music blends detailed sound design with a cinematic sense of darkness, creating deep mental journeys and powerful nighttime energy on the dancefloor.

With a signature style marked by high BPMs, hypnotic storytelling and dense psychedelic layers, Anchronorium delivers a modern and impactful interpretation of the dark psychedelic spectrum. The project continues to evolve with new releases and performances, establishing a strong and distinctive presence within contemporary DarkPsy.

name: Balku
bio:
Directly from Transubtil Records, Balku brings his unique energy and unmistakable sound to guide us in a transcendental experience.

At just 23 years old, this young talent is already standing out on the forest and darkpsy scenes, captivating hearts and minds wherever he goes. His music is an intense fusion of hypnotic textures, deep beats and immersive atmospheres, transporting us to a dimension where dance and connection with nature become one.

From his soul to your brain, Balku is Andre Varandas from Coimbra, Portugal.

name: Dr Fractal
bio:
Dr Fractal is a psytrance project that has evolved over the years through different musical paths, both within electronic music and beyond. A musician since childhood and a drummer in different bands, he gradually discovered the wide spectrum of electronic genres, moving through dub, drum'n'bass and techno, before falling in love with psytrance.

His music stands out because he has always chosen to swim against the tide, drawing inspiration from what he listens to without ever trying to replicate it. Instead, he has developed a personal sound marked by deep and immersive atmospheres, sharp and powerful beats and a sought-after sound design: a rich and evocative sonic identity.

Rather than following trends or fitting into predefined molds, Dr Fractal aims above all to offer a unique auditory experience, one that resonates both physically and emotionally.

name: Intrapsyche
bio:
Intrapsyche was born in 2023 as the night psy project of Francesco Silvestri Belloni, an Italian sound designer with a passion for blending natural sounds and digital soundscapes, defined by a psychedelic groove and a twist of dark.

In 2026 he joins the Transubtil adventure.

name: La Marquise
bio:
La Marquise, or Angélo, has been creating music for over fifteen years. He discovered psytrance in 2012 and immediately fell in love with the genre, drawn above all by its textures and sonic richness.

His style sits somewhere between groovy night psy and slightly darker atmospheres, while keeping a playful, mischievous and driving energy. La Marquise crafts live sets where movement, sonic substance and surprise are at the heart of the experience.

He joined Transubtil Records in 2019. His first EP, Precisely Nowhere, was released in 2023. He also recorded two sets for Radiozora, in 2020 and 2022, and has contributed to numerous compilations over the years. La Marquise is a constantly evolving project, driven by a passion for sound and a desire to take listeners on a journey.

name: Opsuruus
bio:
Sandro Viegas from Portugal is the creative mind behind Opsuruus, one of the rising names in the new generation of Portuguese darkpsy and dark forest artists. His music unfolds through unpredictable moments, always guided by a core concept: contrast. Contrast of feelings, atmospheres and sonic textures.

He is known for delivering infectious energy on the dancefloor, blending hypnotic drive with bursts of pure, controlled insanity that take the audience on an intense and vibrant journey. Sandro had the privilege of learning from artists such as Grub, Rawar, Ulvae and Gandhabba, who played an important role throughout his artistic path.

With focus, dedication and an increasingly defined identity, Opsuruus promises a path full of evolution and power.

name: Vakarm
bio:
Vakarm is the new project born from the combination of Dr Fractal and Pakkun.

The desire to go deeper and darker gave a project focused on the drums, the atmospheres and the most intense side of psytrance. Its emphasis on dark atmospheres and more minimalistic vibes is meticulously designed to take you on an unforgettable journey.

name: Warp Drive
bio:
Tim aka Warp Drive is a psytrance project hailing from the sunny shores of Sydney, Australia.

Bootstrapped in the late 2010s after many sleepless nights in the woods, it is a mix of cultural influences packed into a night psy skin. His first album came out on Transubtil in 2025. Bon appétit!

name: Xipe Totecs
bio:
Xipe Totecs is a psytrance project from Japan, started in 2018. They keep exploring music from the rave scene, producing powerful sounds. Their universe encompasses epic themes and colorful, frenzied drums, creating trance music full of new sonorities.

In 2020 they signed to the French label Transubtil Records. They released their first EP, Evil in the Shell, in June 2022, which reached number 1 in several music charts. The same year they started touring in Mexico, Brazil and Europe. Having overcome the global pandemic, the band has been active in Japan and abroad.

name: Yellow Mellow
bio:
Yellow Mellow is a psytrance live project designed by João Porto, born with the intention of thanking and contributing to psychedelic culture.

Curious and passionate about music from an early age, he wasn't always a psytrance lover: he only truly discovered it at 21, when friends invited him to a party in the middle of the woods. Fascinated by this first impact with the scene, he wanted to give back to listeners around the world what other artists had given him: his own frequencies, offered as a form of auditory medicine.

Yellow Mellow's sound is characterized by serious basslines combined with unpredictable leads and spooky atmospheres: a middle ground between light and shadow, between science and superstition.

name: Zeo
bio:
Candice aka Zeo started mixing psytrance in 2016, with dark and forest influences but also a very groovy side. In 2018 she embarked on music production, always aiming to make her audience travel through her emotions, her influences and her musical perception.

What she loves about this style is that it is both dark and colorful, hypnotic and absorbing, yet very energetic: music you can live introspectively or, on the contrary, in a hyper communicative and synergistic way. After a few years of preparation, her live set is finally ready to reveal the plots of her little universe.

name: Agop
bio:
Agop is a DJ, producer and sound engineer who grew up within alternative artistic communities and was exposed to electronic music from an early age. This environment sparked a lasting fascination for psychedelic sounds, leading him to start DJing as a teenager. His first steps behind the decks took place at private parties, a formative playground where he refined his technique and built his connection with a passionate crowd.

Today his project explores the many facets of the psytrance spectrum, blending groove, energy and hypnotic atmospheres. As a professional sound technician, he also has a strong interest in the technical side of music, working on live sound for bands and for several electronic and psytrance festivals. In 2025 he played at Hadra Trance Festival and joined Transubtil Records.

name: Akhaba
style: Dark prog · Psy techno · Night psy · Darkpsy
bio:
Antoine, aka Akhaba and Kubba, is a DJ, producer and sound engineer from the south of France, passionate about modern psychedelic music for more than a decade. A true propagator of sound, he adapts his performances to the moment and the energy of the dancefloor, seducing underground crowds while keeping his music accessible to a wider audience.

Now part of Transubtil Records, Akhaba delivers powerful night-time psytrance: groovy, dark and immersive. His sound remains firmly rooted in the dancefloor yet unfolds as a unique, reflective journey that captivates both body and mind.

Kubba is Antoine's techno-driven project. A true laboratory of exploration, his DJ sets travel through techno, psy-techno and even quirky shades of tech house. With Kubba, every performance is eclectic, unpredictable and always a joyful playground behind the decks.

name: Art2Fly
bio:
Eduardo Ramírez Herrera, also known as Art2Fly, started as a DJ in 2010. He is originally from Tabasco and currently lives in Yucatán, Mexico.

He co-founded Trance México in 2018 and joined the French label Transubtil Records in 2020, releasing his first compilation, Ta-na-tsiic.

name: Dirge
bio:
Dirge is the twilight psytrance project of Melbourne-born Mike O'Shard.

For 11 years he has spread a strange and sinister signal across Australian dancefloors: a dark broadcast transmitted by shadow, a message sent by the frequency of night.

Mike managed the Ascension Stage at Esoteric Festival in Australia from 2017 to 2024, and currently represents Transubtil Records and MMD Records from Cape Town, South Africa, as a label DJ.

name: Fiorenza
bio:
Part of the feminine underground scene of the Cerrado, Fiorenza turns nocturnal sound into a powerful expression of feeling.

Moving between 155 and 170 BPM, her sets travel through the textures of forest and dark, crafting a psychedelic sonic journey with heavy basslines and immersive atmospheres.

name: Heavy Fawn
bio:
Heavy Fawn is the night psy DJ project of Hugo, originally from Marseille, France. He discovered psytrance and free parties in 2009 and instantly fell in love with the music. In 2017 he met Tantra Music, began collaborating with them as a DJ and organizer, and together they made some of the best darkpsy festivals in southern France.

In 2020 he joined the French label Transubtil Records and played in Mexico and Costa Rica. In 2024 he joined the Brazilian label Resina Records, a major inspiration for years. His first VA, a collaboration between Resina and Transubtil Records featuring only exclusive tracks, is set for release in early 2026.

His goal is to create DJ sets that are neither forest, nor dark, nor twilight, nor hitech, but a perfect blend that is purely psychedelic.

name: Ingred
bio:
Ingred is dedicated to a meticulous curation of tracks that go beyond the obvious, focusing on dense atmospheres and dynamic structures that define her sonic signature. After three years under the name Lysergic Nature, the project evolved and took on the identity of its creator: Ingred.

She represents Transubtil Records, a label focused on intense, high-quality underground psytrance, and focuses on high-energy styles such as full-on night and forest (155 BPM and up). The project's key distinction lies in its rigorous sonic research.

name: Jive
bio:
Jive is the DJ project of Jai Royall, representing Transubtil Records. Spawned in 2017, the project was developed as a tool to research and further understand the symbiosis between unearthly sonic textures and deep rhythmic structures.

Jive is also the co-founder of Murky Collective and event director of Swampy Conscience. Catch Jive generating forest portals up and around the east coast of Oz.

name: Kanaloa
bio:
Marcus is the DJ and producer behind the psytrance project Kanaloa. He has been playing at events and festivals across the Western Hemisphere for over 20 years, all around the UK and Europe. His dedication to mastering the art of psychedelic sound and creating unique experiences has driven him deep into the world of psychedelic music.

Representing Transubtil Records, Kanaloa drives atmospheric and deep sounds, combining distorted textures with forest-friendly elements and organic soundscapes, enveloping the imagination in a fresh new style. Expect dark-edged and twisted night-time grooves.

name: Mekanorms
bio:
Originally rooted in punk rock and hard rock, Mekanorms discovered the world of psytrance in 2010, and it was love at first sight. The turntables immediately captivated him: he bought his first setup and began his journey as a DJ.

Over the years he refined his technique and forged his own signature style, making each of his sets instantly recognizable: groovy, nocturnal psytrance infused with high-frequency, mechanical sounds.

He has been part of Transubtil Records since the very beginning of the label's story, and has since performed on dancefloors around the world alongside international artists.

name: Pakkun
bio:
Pakkun, aka Vincent, has always been passionate about music, playing drums and bass guitar from a young age. He discovered electronic music through techno and drum'n'bass, then soon fell in love with psytrance. Learning the art of DJing with the Transubtil crew led him to join the label at the end of 2019, and to play in Japan in summer 2022.

Constantly evolving, his sets range from groovy psytrance to darkpsy. Now working a lot on production, he is eager to show you his own vision of psytrance: his first compilation, Chaos Simulator, includes his first release with Dr Fractal, with more to come this year.

name: Rajax
bio:
William dived into the psytrance world in 2013: a passion quickly grew and his project Rajax was born. His debut on stage came in 2015 with the Outrance association. In 2017 he joined the Senoï Project association, and in March 2019, with its support, he launched his first compilation, Genome.

In 2023 he joined the growing label Transubtil Records and started delivering darker and faster DJ sets, while his love for the groove remains intact. Each of his performances is unique and makes a strong impact on the dancefloor, confirming his place in the psytrance scene and creating unforgettable moments for the audience.

name: Uechi
bio:
Having spent years immersed in the trance scene, attending countless parties across Japan and abroad, Uechi experienced the culture from the dancefloor long before stepping behind the decks. His passion for dancing naturally evolved into a desire to create dancefloors through music, and in 2023 he officially began his journey as a DJ.

Drawing on years of experience as a dancer and dedicated partygoer, he quickly established a distinctive style. Rooted in dark psy and forest psy, Uechi delivers high-energy sets that fuse deep grooves with powerful driving momentum. Every set is crafted from a dancer's perspective, with one goal in mind: to keep the dancefloor moving from the very first beat to the very last.

name: Wild Track
bio:
Wild Track is a Moroccan DJ, formerly known as DJ Gender Fluid. He crafts tailored DJ sets based on the vibe of the dancefloor, staying fully tuned in to its energy. Groovy and psychedelic, his mixes become the ideal soundtrack for active meditation, trance and free-form dance.

Immersed in the global psytrance scene as a festival traveler and party organizer long before stepping behind the decks, he developed an endless curiosity for digging the most powerful, groovy and mind-shifting tracks. His mission: channel the same magic he once felt in the crowd and deliver it back to the dancefloor.

Deeply engaged in music, he is also the founder of Yaz Records and Universitek, an educational organization dedicated to sharing knowledge and nurturing creativity within the musical community.

name: Yagsa
bio:
Yagsa started mixing in 2010 after discovering trance at Hadra Festival. In 2014 he joined the Transubtil association and started performing on big dancefloors.

Now on the Transubtil Records label, he has released a compilation in collaboration with Mekanorms, Transsiberian. Come and discover his universe of forest and psychedelic atmospheres.
